title: Control 1.1: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization

checks.description: Environment Maker role not assigned to All Users
Agent publisher security group exists (FSI-Agent-Publishers-Prod)

title: Control 1.2: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management

checks.description: Agent inventory maintained with all agents registered
Authentication mode configured per agent
No orphaned agents (all have active owner)

checks.description: SharePoint permission inheritance not broken on grounding sites
No oversharing detected on knowledge source sites

manual_question: Have site permission reviews been completed in the last 90 days for all agent knowledge sources?

checks.description: DLP policy exists covering agent environments
ACP allowlist configured for approved connectors
Blocked connector list enforced

title: Control 1.5: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Sensitivity Labels

checks.description: DLP policy scoped to agent environments
Sensitivity label policies enabled

title: Control 1.6: Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI

checks.description: DSPM for AI policy exists in Purview

manual_question: Has a DSPM for AI scan been reviewed with findings actioned in the last 30 days?

title: Control 1.7: Comprehensive Audit Logging and Compliance

M365 Audit plan tier is E5 or equivalent

title: Control 1.8: Runtime Protection and External Threat Detection

checks.description: Sentinel alerts configured for agent anomalies

manual_question: Have runtime protection alerts been reviewed and tuned in the last 30 days?

title: Control 1.9: Data Retention and Deletion Policies

checks.description: Retention policy scoped to Copilot interactions exists
Retention duration meets zone requirements

checks.description: Communication compliance policy targeting agents exists

manual_question: Has the supervision review queue been reviewed by a compliance officer in the last 30 days?

Phishing-resistant MFA required for Zone 3

title: Control 1.12: Insider Risk Detection and Response

checks.description: Insider risk policy exists with Copilot interactions in scope

manual_question: Have any insider risk alerts related to agent use been reviewed and dispositioned this quarter?

manual_question: Has data minimization been applied to restrict agent context to only the data necessary for each agent's specific function?

checks.description: TLS 1.2+ enforced for all connections
At-rest encryption verified via tenant settings

checks.description: Endpoint DLP policy exists in Purview

manual_question: Is endpoint DLP enforced on all endpoints from which agents are accessed, including unmanaged devices?

title: Control 1.18: Application-Level Authorization and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

checks.description: RBAC role assignments readable and least-privilege enforced
No excessive admin role assignments for agent operations

manual_question: Has a least-privilege access review for all agent administrative roles been completed in the last 90 days?

title: Control 1.19: eDiscovery for Agent Interactions

checks.description: eDiscovery case includes agent interaction data source
eDiscovery search covers Copilot interaction content types

checks.description: Private endpoint or VNet integration configured for PPAC
Network isolation enforced for production environments

title: Control 1.21: Adversarial Input Logging

checks.description: Audit log captures prompt/response pairs

manual_question: Is adversarial input logging reviewed on a scheduled basis, and are prompt injection attempts being tracked?

title: Control 1.22: Information Barriers for AI Agents

checks.description: Information barrier policy exists and is active
IB segments cover agent-accessible data boundaries

title: Control 1.23: Step-Up Authentication for AI Agent Operations

checks.description: Step-up authentication companion solution deployed

manual_question: Has step-up authentication been tested end-to-end for all Zone 3 operations in the last 60 days?

manual_question: Provide evidence of weekly (Zone 2) or daily (Zone 3) security recommendation reviews, including reviewer names, dates, and actions taken on identified AI security gaps.

title: Control 1.25: MIME Type Restrictions for File Uploads

checks.description: MIME type restrictions configured per zone template
Blocked file extensions enforced

Sensitivity label inheritance configured for uploaded files

checks.description: Content moderation level set per agent

checks.description: DLP publishing restrictions enforced in agent environments
Security scan gate enabled for production publishing

checks.description: GSA baseline profile linked to Copilot Studio CA policy
Web content filtering policy blocks unapproved categories

manual_question: Provide evidence of weekly (Zone 2) or daily (Zone 3) GSA traffic log review, including reviewer names, dates, false positive assessments, and escalation decisions for anomalous blocked requests.

title: Control 2.1: Managed Environments

checks.description: All production environments have IsManaged: true
Managed environment policies enforced

title: Control 2.2: Environment Groups and Tier Classification

checks.description: Environment groups exist with zone mapping
Zone 1/2/3 tier classification present for all environments

title: Control 2.3: Change Management and Release Planning

checks.description: Approval workflow present for agent promotions

manual_question: Is the change management workflow enforced for all Zone 3 agent promotions, with evidence stored in your ITSM system?

title: Control 2.4: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery

checks.description: DR documentation present in SharePoint governance site

manual_question: Has a business continuity failover test been executed and documented for agent-dependent processes in the last 12 months?

title: Control 2.5: Testing, Validation, and Quality Assurance
manual_question: Is there a documented QA process requiring test coverage for agent responses before Zone 2 or Zone 3 promotion?

title: Control 2.6: Model Risk Management (OCC 2011-12/SR 11-7)
manual_question: Has a model risk management review (aligned to OCC 2011-12 / SR 11-7) been completed for any agents serving regulated functions?

title: Control 2.7: Vendor and Third-Party Risk Management
manual_question: Has a vendor risk assessment been completed for all third-party connectors and plugins used by production agents?

title: Control 2.8: Access Control and Segregation of Duties

checks.description: Role assignments match SoD matrix
No individual holds both dev and prod publishing rights

manual_question: Has a segregation of duties review confirmed that no individual has both agent development and production publishing rights?

title: Control 2.9: Agent Performance Monitoring and Optimization

checks.description: Usage metrics available in PPAC for agent environments

manual_question: Are agent performance metrics (latency, fallback rate, escalation rate) reviewed on a scheduled cadence?

title: Control 2.10: Patch Management and System Updates

checks.description: Copilot Studio version and connector versions retrievable

manual_question: Is there a documented patch management process for reviewing and applying Copilot Studio platform updates?

title: Control 2.11: Bias Testing and Fairness Assessment
manual_question: Has bias testing been performed for agents that make recommendations affecting customers, with results documented and reviewed?

title: Control 2.12: Supervision and Oversight (FINRA Rule 3110)
manual_question: Is there a designated supervisory principal for each production agent per FINRA Rule 3110, with a documented review cadence?

title: Control 2.13: Documentation and Record Keeping
manual_question: Is a complete governance record maintained per agent (owner, purpose, data sources, approval chain, test results)?

title: Control 2.14: Training and Awareness Program
manual_question: Have all agent developers, publishers, and administrators completed AI governance training in the last 12 months?

title: Control 2.15: Environment Routing and Auto-Provisioning

checks.description: Environment routing rules configured
Routing enforces zone boundaries

title: Control 2.16: RAG Source Integrity Validation

checks.description: RAG source validation companion solution deployed

manual_question: Are all SharePoint knowledge sources scanned for accuracy and currency on a documented schedule?

title: Control 2.17: Multi-Agent Orchestration Limits

checks.description: Multi-agent orchestration limits set in PPAC

manual_question: Have multi-agent orchestration workflows been reviewed for circular delegation and privilege escalation risks?

title: Control 2.18: Automated Conflict of Interest Testing
manual_question: Has automated conflict-of-interest testing been performed for agents that surface investment recommendations or research?

title: Control 2.19: Customer AI Disclosure and Transparency
manual_question: Is there clear AI disclosure language presented to customers before they interact with any customer-facing agent?

title: Control 2.20: Adversarial Testing and Red Team Framework
manual_question: Has a red team or adversarial testing exercise been conducted for Zone 3 agents, with findings tracked to resolution?

title: Control 2.21: AI Marketing Claims and Substantiation
manual_question: Have all AI marketing claims referencing agent capabilities been reviewed for substantiation and regulatory accuracy?

title: Control 2.22: Inactivity Timeout Enforcement

checks.description: Inactivity timeout configured per environment
Timeout value meets zone requirements (8h Zone2, 4h Zone3)

title: Control 2.23: User Consent and AI Disclosure Enforcement
manual_question: Is user consent captured and logged before any agent accesses personal data, with consent records retained per policy?

title: Control 2.24: Agent Feature Enablement and Restriction Governance

checks.description: Generative AI feature flags reviewed per environment
External plugin toggles set per zone policy

title: Control 2.25: Microsoft Agent 365 — Admin Center Governance Console

checks.description: Agent 365 Admin Center governance console accessible
Agent inventory visible in governance console

title: Control 2.26: Entra Agent ID — Identity Governance for Agents

checks.description: Entra Agent ID identities registered with sponsors
Access packages configured for agent resource bundles

title: Control 3.8: Copilot Hub and Governance Dashboard

Audit logs ingested into Sentinel workspace

manual_question: Are Sentinel alerts for agent-related security signals reviewed by the SOC on a documented cadence?

manual_question: Is there a defined exception management process with documented risk acceptance for controls not yet at target maturity?

manual_question: Are regulatory reporting obligations (SAR, FINRA CAT, exam readiness) specifically addressed in your agent governance program?

manual_question: Has the governance program been reviewed by Internal Audit or an independent risk function in the last 12 months?
